decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks build directly on the firm's core thermoforming-material knowledge in dental technology, and having a page of its own shows the firm is actively committed to them.
PETG thermoforming blanks sit at the heart of the firm's established material and process expertise, so the firm can readily read market feedback and refine the product.
The UV-curing lacquer draws on related light-curing chemistry used in dental and hearing-acoustics labs, though its low website presence suggests weaker positioning.
The intraoral contrast spray complements the firm's digital and impression workflow knowledge, and its dedicated page signals ongoing investment.
Custom earmolds use the firm's established light-curing and impression material know-how in hearing acoustics, making assimilation and improvement feasible.
Custom hearing protection earmolds share the material base of the earmold line, giving the firm relevant knowledge even though the product is only mentioned on the website.
